clues.title: Mismatched signature
clues.flavor: Damon Reyes's signature on this canvas doesn't match the one on his contract. This piece is a forgery wearing his name.

clues.title: Guest sign-in sheet
clues.flavor: Colin Hargrove signed in under 'C. Hart.' He didn't want the front desk connecting his name to Marcus's.

clues.title: Unplugged security camera
clues.flavor: The power cable's been pulled from this unit. Someone didn't want this angle recorded.

clues.title: Champagne flute with lipstick
clues.flavor: The shade matches a lipstick Elena Voss is known to wear. She said she left before the reception ended.

clues.title: Dropped cufflink
clues.flavor: Engraved with a family crest. Not one anyone on staff recognizes - but it matches an old photo of the Hargrove family.

clues.title: Sticky note near the office door
clues.flavor: 'Numbers don't match Q3 - ask E.' in Marcus's handwriting. He'd noticed something was wrong before he died.
